choice.basis: The chart is a dual-axis line plot. The blue solid-line series (Married couple, left axis) is at its lowest point in 2020, while the red dashed-line series (Single women, right axis) is at its highest point in 2020. The red marker for 2020 is visually near the top of the plot area, and the blue marker for 2020 is visually near the bottom. This visual separation indicates that the 2020 count for Single women is significantly larger than the 2020 count for Married couple.
choice.option_label: Open 2020 Single women demographic follow-up record
